title: V4 Question Types Demo A
description: Multi-part, naming (both directions) and dropdown cloze questions, plus the per-question extras: a hint that costs points and a "How sure are you?" row.

questions.stem: Sodium metal is dropped into water: $\ce{2Na + 2H2O -> 2NaOH + H2}$.

parts.text: How many moles of $\ce{H2}$ form from 4 mol of Na?

questions.explanation: Hydrogen gas is released, and the 2:1 ratio of Na to H2 gives 2 mol from 4 mol of Na.
Copper is +2 here, and five waters of hydration give the prefix penta-.

questions.text: Write the formula for this compound.
questions.explanation: Two Fe3+ ions balance three O2- ions.

questions.text: Sodium is a [[b1]] and chlorine is a [[b2]], so NaCl is [[b3]].
questions.explanation: A metal and a nonmetal transfer electrons, which makes an ionic compound.

questions.text: Which particle carries a negative charge?
questions.explanation: Electrons are negative; protons are positive and neutrons are neutral.
